title: White Light Scanning to Aid Body Contouring: A Pilot Project
brief_summary: A white light scanner can more accurately measure body contouring subjects than standard anthropomorphic methods.
study_population: Healthy, prospective, surgical candidates for body contouring surgery, including: lipoplasty, abdominoplasty, breast reduction, breast augmentation, thigh lift,and brachioplasty are being asked to participate in this research project.
